QUOTE: "`mbedtls_mutex_init/lock/unlock/free` are function pointers (`include/mbedtls/threading.h:105–161`), defaulting to the pthread implementation in `threading.c`." and "The library itself (`library/`) has no spawn sites."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that library/ has no thread spawn sites and that library/ supplies the mutex abstraction (init/lock/unlock/free in threading.c) for threaded use.
